messages:
maya: Heads up — discovered a retro discount that was applied after invoicing for a subset of Beta customers in May. It looks like ~$42,300 in total was issued as account credits during the period but invoices were already recognized. Need guidance on month-end treatment.

leo: Ugh. Do we have a list of affected invoices/customers?

maya: Yes, exporting now. Will paste a short summary — 7 customers, credits posted using the /apply-credit flow on 2026-05-27, invoices dated between 2026-05-01 and 2026-05-10.

maya: Quick question: should we reverse revenue in May or book a contra-revenue/deferral and adjust next month when credits hit? What do auditors want? :thinking_face:

ashley: Typically if the credit is contractual/retrospective and issued in the same period as the billing error, we adjust the period where the refund/credit was issued. But since invoices were recognized already and close is tonight, we need a manual JE.

leo: What's the recommended JE? Reduce recognized revenue and increase accounts receivable or record contra-revenue?

ashley: We usually post a contra-revenue entry when it’s a pricing/discount adjustment — debit Revenue, credit Customer Credit Liability (temporary liability) so cash/AR not touched until credit is redeemed.

sanjay: Can you draft the numbers? We should show the draft JE in the thread so Ops can pre-approve.

maya: Draft below (rounded):

```
Date: 2026-05-31
DR 4000-SaaS Revenue              $42,300
CR 2450-Customer Credit Liability $42,300
Memo: Retro pricing experiment credits applied after invoicing; contra-revenue to reflect issued credits for May invoices.
```

maya: This preserves revenue recognition for customers who keep the service but reflects the credit issued. When the credit is redeemed or applied to future invoices, we'd move liability to AR/Cash clearance.

leo: Looks right to me. Two quick asks: 1) Can we get impact on ARR/MRR dashboard asap? 2) Need sign-off from RevOps (Sasha) and GL owner before posting.

acct-bot: Export of affected invoices attached: export_invoices_may27.csv (automated).

ashley: MRR impact — this reduces recognized revenue in May, so MRR should reflect the net after credits. If we want to keep MRR apples-to-apples, we can tag this as an experimental adjustment in the Close notes.

maya: Sending to Sasha now. @sasha — can you review/approve the JE and the proposed liability account?

sanjay: Also flagging tax team — will credits affect sales tax reporting? If taxable, we need a tax JE too.

maya: Good point. @tax-team — any quick guidance?

leo: If taxable, tax base reduces with the credit. We should estimate tax impact and book tax liability adjustment. Might be small but don't ignore.

ashley: For audit trace, we should attach the /apply-credit tickets (links) and the invoice export to the JE.

maya: Sasha approved in DM. She asked to include a short narrative and to route the JE through the month-end approval workflow.

sanjay: I'll prepare the AP/GL entry and route for approval. Target to post before EOD close.

maya: Thanks. One last ask — can Product confirm this was intended behaviour for the experiment? If not, we may need to reverse the credits and re-bill. @product-team

leo: I'll ping Maya if Product wants reversal. For now proceed with contra-revenue JE and tax estimate.

maya: Updated timeline: prepare JE + supporting docs by 2pm PT, route for RevOps & GL owner sign-off, post before close at 6pm PT.

acct-bot: JE template pre-filled and uploaded: JE_1955004321_contra_rev.xlsx

ashley: Approved from my side. Post the JE with memo and attach all supporting CSVs/tickets.

sanjay: Posting plan in case of tax impact > $500: book tax adjustment JE and notify external tax advisor.

maya: All set. Will update thread when JE is posted. :white_check_mark:
